methodology: Overrides are used only when standardized SEC CompanyFacts cannot determine the strategy float pillar.
A pass requires a filing-supported upper bound below 10,000,000 units of the security that actually trades under the ticker.
A fail may use a filing-supported lower bound above 10,000,000 freely saleable or effectively registered trading units when the exact public float is unavailable.
ADS issuers are evaluated in listed ADS-equivalent units, not raw underlying ordinary-share units.
Unresolved cases remain unknown and fail closed.

evidence.fact: 21,448,632 ordinary shares outstanding; Datongyi Holding Limited beneficially holds 20,000,000 ordinary shares through the controlling shareholder.

JLHL.notes: At most 1,448,632 ordinary shares are outside the disclosed controlling block, so the public/trading float cannot exceed the 10M threshold.

evidence.fact: The listed security is an ADS representing 240 Class B ordinary shares; 1,082,525,650 Class B shares were outstanding as of March 31, 2026.
A 901,408,450 Class B share debt conversion was submitted for shareholder approval, which shareholders approved on July 8, 2026.

TDTH.calculation: (1,082,525,650 + 901,408,450) / 240 = 8,266,392.083 ADS-equivalent units; rounded up to 8,266,392 for the conservative test-date upper bound.
TDTH.notes: Even assuming the full approved debt-conversion issuance was outstanding by July 9, the entire Class B share base represents fewer than 10M listed ADS units. Actual float cannot exceed total ADS-equivalent Class B shares.

evidence.fact: Registered offering of 40,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.25 per share.
Company reported approximately $9.8175M net proceeds from the offering.

RPGL.notes: The completed registered primary offering alone places at least 40M listed Class A ordinary shares into the public-offering supply, above the 10M threshold.

evidence.fact: At the business-combination closing, lock-up restrictions were expressly waived on 30,102,200 Class A ordinary shares held by Xingyun International.
The registration statement covers potential resale of up to 30,102,200 Xingyun Class A ordinary shares.
Registration statement File No. 333-296779 became effective June 24, 2026.

PLBL.notes: This is a conservative trading-supply rejection, not a claim that SEC Rule 405 public float equaled 30.1M on July 9. The shares were both lock-up-waived and covered by an effective resale registration before the test date, so available registered supply exceeded the strategy threshold.

evidence.fact: 1,139,246 Class A ordinary shares were freely transferable as of the annual report; major acquisition blocks were subject to multi-year lock-ups, but remaining Class A shares were described as potentially saleable subject to Rules 144 and 701.
March 30, 2026 acquisition issued 87,400,144 additional Class A ordinary shares subject to a 60-month lock-up.

MAAS.notes: The filings prove a small immediately free block and long lock-ups on the largest acquisition issuances, but do not establish a rigorous July 9 upper bound for all residual Rule 144-eligible shares. MomentumBot therefore fails this name closed rather than inventing an exact float.
